title: Conditional κ = .00389011527141 (+0.00000501039162510749% over #8027): bound paid moments on the paired supplier
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ = 0.00389011527141, a gain of +0.00000501039162510749% over #8027.** On the strongest independently reproduced external comparator, Ali Romman’s #8027 at `fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4`, κ = 0.00389011507650. The exact gain is 0.00000000019491 and the exact percentage is (12994/2593410051)%. The new witness uses the same 768-factor word, fixed carrier, admissible prime, ownership and restored stock, 36-call binary supplier, 48-call rational supplier and signed caller `156fdf3a4a129b39225fd6ca51011de27974d7f104e8b04907c17ed5344bc858`. The maintainer-selected record remains #7000. [Exact external comparator](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4/research/p104-live-relative-gain) · [Selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/selected-result.json)

**Subsequent peer comparison.** After this result was published, Ali Romman reported the same κ = 0.00389011527141 for another physical installation in #8030. The difference against that reported value is exactly 0 (0%). This campaign verified the #8029 package independently. The percentage in the title uses the strongest reproduced peer at publication, #8027. [Peer report](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8030) · [Exact peer revision](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/3308ff29122688eb42eb85f3de068973fb212a15/research/single-band-native-carriers)

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Peer #8027 | 0.003890115076583 | 0.00389011507657 | 0.00389011507650 | — |
| Same-prime delayed cover | 0.003890115176583 | 0.00389011517657 | 0.00389011517650 | 0.00000000010000 |
| Normalized 623rd-power bound | 0.003890115197377 | 0.00389011519736 | 0.00389011519729 | 0.00000000002079 |
| Completed-label tail, 128th moment | 0.003890115260308 | 0.00389011526029 | 0.00389011526022 | 0.00000000006293 |
| Coordinatewise 40th moment | 0.003890115271496 | 0.00389011527148 | **0.00389011527141** | **0.00000000001119** |

The two weighted proofs added in `c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb` gain 0.00000000007412 over the normalized predecessor. The final step gains exactly (18650/64835254337)% over the independently signed p=128 result. Both weighted estimates use the actual binary paid inventory of 104,904 one-letter positions, retain the 18,906 productive positions as a separate histogram, and charge the entire positive paid mass introduced by splitting. [Weighted proofs and source pins](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/weighted)

## What changed

1. At the original carrier H = 299610000000000, the full delayed-cover surcharge is below 2⁻³⁹. A debit of 1/(H · 2³⁸) pays it on the original admissible prime. The normalized all-size leaf estimate at h=1024 and p=623 then reduces the uniform debit to 23731/H. Both complete predecessor applications are replayed. [Cover proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ec871845390b9a8b8f73c2fc17762251bceb8c34/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/PROOF.md) · [Normalized proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a9dbc75e68e8c645df425adc489234d22df67f8d/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/normalized/PROOF.md)
2. The p=128 proof bounds the completed paid-label mass above normalized rank 4/5. Its L¹²⁸ norm is below 9/10. Two endpoint inequalities apply at every exit height and reduce the terminal debit to 4876/H. The earlier mean-only bounds failed at coefficients 8 and 11, and the latter bound failed at finite heights 11–17. They are retained as controls for choosing the changed method. [Paid-tail proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/weighted/PROOF.md) · [Scoped exclusions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/45bc0aaf5409efded08373ba52ea8136fed23b6c/paired-768/README.md)
3. The p=40 proof uses the actual one-letter support and directed mean to bound the fortieth moment of 768 coordinates. Two implementations check 41 factorial-moment terms and all 769 binomial atoms. The split-adjusted L⁴⁰ norm is below 7/10, giving terminal debit 1524/H. The complete saving exceeds even the old raw upper endpoint minus 4876/H, with every other old loss forgiven, by 6528443/5992200000000000000. The stronger bound comes from repricing the all-size paid exits under the original contracts. [Fortieth-moment proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/weighted/moment/PROOF.md) · [Independent proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/weighted/moment/independent/PROOF.md)

## Reproduce

From a clean checkout of this PR, use CPython 3.12 and the standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-paired-delayed-cover
```

The registered command authenticates the 30-file #8027 tree and its 134-member source closure, rebuilds the four ordinary bootstrap stages for each supplier, replays all four signed applications and checks their independent receipts. It accounts for the ordinary work, precision, tape, routing and restoration obligations. Both new applications passed locally, including the independent reconstruction of the signed 48-call invoice, 54 strict inequalities and four functional checks. The extra paid rank-one position, cap equality and one-smaller terminal numerator are rejected. The p=128 and p=40 cold application runs took 76.708 and 74.473 seconds respectively. The combined registered limit is 600 seconds. [Portable command, exact inputs and resources](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/README.md)

|---|---|---|
| p=128 | `65473eba091d40551586a3e078bb6c4155813ba64e7207e0698765a2e738da0d` | `32d40619c37fdcf91f63930e3ebdf1ec0e19210f91e4f1a74617fcc1b3ada10c` |
| p=40 | `0fed060d852e6e37c1ff4ffe514d5765c9efdd6e0a3a24f6bc59cbbdcc7b0d79` | `0b179d16461707f2ec6b0ea02149b1dfef0f667a051da475fa400713a01f6377` |

The earlier head `ec871845390b9a8b8f73c2fc17762251bceb8c34` passed hosted planning, the separate historical replay and the registered science job, which emitted `PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT_SIGNED_ACCEPTANCE` and `PASS_PAIRED_DELAYED_COVER`. The distinct prerequisite commit `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026` reuses #7257’s selected-CI guide and historical-snapshot repair and contributes zero to the scientific gain. [Hosted cover replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44930268875/job/136926406408) · [CI repair](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257)

The normalized predecessor at `a9dbc75e68e8c645df425adc489234d22df67f8d` passed the local registered replay in 150.63 seconds and local onboarding with 760 tests, 31 skipped. Hosted planning, the historical prerequisite and the science job passed. The job emitted `PASS_PAIRED_NORMALIZED_COVER` and `PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT_NORMALIZED_ACCEPTANCE` at 0.00389011519729. [Hosted normalized replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44931538420/job/136930133839)

The clean registered replay on `c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb` passed in 300.95 seconds. It emitted all four scientific markers, including `PASS_PAIRED_SOURCE_MOMENT` at 0.00389011527141. Onboarding passed 760 tests with 31 local skips in 136.168 seconds. The planner selected this package and the historical prerequisite. All three hosted jobs passed on this exact head. The scientific job reproduced all four complete results, including `PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT_40TH_MOMENT_ACCEPTANCE` and `PASS_PAIRED_SOURCE_MOMENT` at 0.00389011527141. [Hosted scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44932940455/job/136934402900) · [Complete hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44932940455)

## Premises, scope and credit

This conditional claim inherits #8027’s five premises for native action on all columns, owned erasure, compiler transfer, precision and tape, and analytic recovery. The binary and rational raw crossings remain those of #8027. The scientific contribution is the four source-bound all-size proofs and their use in the complete signed application. Review and selection remain with maintainers.

Ali Romman supplied the paired native circuits and complete #8027 application. Clear1nsight supplied the iterated-return programs, literal compiler, independent scalar readers and audited caller. Jacob Alan Sussman supplied the integer fixed-batch flow, DreamingOfClouds the ambient-cap extension, and zxv the normalized and weighted-exit proofs. The separate #8026 contribution supplied the direct-carrier, paid-log-moment and split-uplift arguments on the earlier 451-factor supplier. Here those ideas are proved for #8027’s 768-factor word, actual carrier, four-stage stock and complete signed consumer. The original notices credit the further physical, precision and analytic predecessors. OpenAI Codex materially assisted with the proofs, implementation and independent replay.
